title: 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) Mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q1
elements.title: What is the general normal-text contrast threshold?
elements.feedback: Normal text generally requires at least 4.5:1.

elements.name: q2
elements.title: Does 4.49:1 meet a 4.5:1 threshold?
elements.feedback: Do not round a measured ratio up to the threshold.

elements.name: q3
elements.title: What is the general threshold for qualifying large text?
elements.feedback: Large-scale text generally requires at least 3:1.
